title: Operational diagnostics and Registry/service-version contract qualification
objective: Qualify the repository troubleshooting and protocol/version surfaces used by developers and operators: status/readiness/capabilities diagnostics plus Registry service/version provenance and error handling.

owns: capabilities advertisement of troubleshooting and Registry endpoints
Indexer-client canonical-authority rejection for service-version reads

defects_remediated: Explorer NetworkStatus omitted the Indexer's categorical runtime issue and issue timestamp, reducing troubleshooting provenance
direct service-version reads trusted returned service/version identity without checking it matched the request
direct service-version reads did not reject missing activation provenance or impossible deprecation state
Registry service detail did not prove activeVersion and implementation matched an active historical version
acceptance_criteria: status and readiness preserve chain/finality/freshness/runtime diagnostic provenance and fail closed
capabilities advertise the qualified troubleshooting and Registry API contracts
service-version lookup fails closed on identity, activation, or deprecation inconsistencies
Registry service detail fails closed when active-version or implementation linkage contradicts history
qualification_tests: status and ready degraded responses include machine-readable issue plus Indexer runtime detail
Registry active-version/history and implementation/history mismatch rejection
Indexer client canonical-authority overclaim rejection for service-version reads
